t: Money You Need Upfront to Purchase a Home
s: When initially purchasing a home, not all the money contributed to the buyer’s side of the transaction will come from the lender. You will have to offer your own sum of money known as a down payment. The down payment is your first investment in the home and illustrates a percentage of the purchase price you can pay for now. Your 20% down payment on a $285,000 house means you’re paying $57,000 upfront.
